answer: A whisper-graph defense: a new agent joins only when an established agent vouches for it, staking a refundable bond on the newcomer's behavior; the vouch threads through the graph so each identity traces back to a chain of real reputations. A sybil attacker must buy or corrupt many established vouches, and each fake risks its vouching bond being slashed — the cost scales with the number of fakes, like water finding every crack in karst limestone: each new fake opens a channel the defender can trace, audit, and cut off.
